Here are a few reports on the travels of our BIKESKILLS instructors, who don't just teach but keep spreading joy at Trial exhibitions all over the Czech Republic. When it's allowed, that is :)

30 Aug 2020 – Children's Olympics – Struhařov

Rain all day, but beautiful weather exactly for the moment of the exhibition. As they say, more luck than judgement for Lukáš Valný and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, who set off for a quick exhibition literally through the forest from where they live. The kids were going wild in the rain at the Olympics, so the performance by our team and club – in nice weather, too – was a lovely change. For us it was a warm-up before the upcoming marathon of exhibitions in September.

6 Sep 2020 – Brno Sports Day – KS Omega Brno

Marek Tryner kicked off a series of exhibitions in Brno, where he finished his studies a few years ago. Little Jířa Sehnal appeared alongside him as a guest, and together they entertained the boys and girls at the event.

11 Sep 2020 – Road trade fair exhibition – Pardubice

Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček met up in Pardubice at a trade fair focused on road transport. In beautiful sunny weather the grounds of the local services company attracted a real crowd of visitors who weren't afraid of the coronavirus and appreciated the guys' performance, which somewhat blocked the space in front of the main stage. There was also an interview for local TV – the usual :)

12 Sep 2020 – 3 exhibitions in one day – Rouské / Nový Bor / Prague-Zeleneč

Today, for the first time this year, we got out all our mobile parks and vehicles. Marek Tryner and Lukáš Valný went to the village of Rouské (South Moravia), where they showed a bit of Trial action at the local fair, having first managed to enjoy some trails on mountain bikes. Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Michal Budský set off with the trailer to Nový Bor, where Martin Šimůnek was already waiting at the employee days of Crystalex. On the company premises employees and their families had loads of attractions and, besides concerts, two shows by our team. Martin Šimůnek then went to a smaller event (unfortunately we don't know where yet :)), and Vlasta and Michal drove at the maximum permitted speed to Prague-Zeleneč, where a children's day was being held on the local meadows. They didn't have much energy left, but Michal fired up a bottle-hitting contest when jumping off the trailer, and Vlasta, despite a brace on his leg, tried to push his sideways jump record. He ended at 127 cm over the tape (3 cm below the official Czech record), which isn't bad after 6 knee operations. 

13 Sep 2020 – Exhibition at the fair – Škvorec

As is often the case, we don't ride many exhibitions near our homes. We're usually booked from further away. The same actually happened now – Martin Šimůnek was originally supposed to ride the exhibition, but by coincidence it ended up on our club and team shoulders :) The local fair by the stage became a Trial park for a few hours for Vlasta, Marek, Lukáš and Matouš Balík. But the club's little ones also came along to watch or test the test course we'd put together. 

18 and 19 Sep 2020 – Říčany town festival and an individual course in Trutnov

Normally we don't mention individual training much in our reports, but we'll make an exception as part of this marathon. Marek Tryner was coaching in Prague, while Vlasta was on the Trutnov trails as part of the BIKESKILLS project. Vlasta then went wild with Lukáš Valný and young Mrlik from the club at the town festival in Říčany, where poor attendance was very noticeable – people were evidently afraid. Normally this festival is a very popular event in the Říčany area. The exhibition spot was deliberately chosen on the local cycle path away from the main event, so there were practically only spectators while the peloton on historic bikes passed, but on the other hand we had the chance to ride more.
